name: build a jq filter pipeline transforming a json array of records
definition: Compose a filter chain with a filtered status, a renamed shape, formatted date, an array-length and first-element extraction, and a sort, outputting a new array of objects.
failure_mode: a dropped field or mis-mapping fails the per-record checks

name: complete a low-rank matrix from sparse row/column/value observations
definition: reconstruct a full matrix that closely approximates the underlying low-rank matrix given only a sampled set of row indices, column indices, and observed values.
failure_mode: missing a robust reconstruction algorithm gives spectral error above tolerance on >10% of trials
